account_id.description: Your sandbox AWS account ID (12 digits). Policies are built from it so the plan can be checked offline.

availability_zones.description: One subnet (and one endpoint network interface, billed per hour) per zone. Use one zone to halve the endpoint cost.

destination_regions.description: Where the profile may route a request from var.region. Check: aws bedrock get-inference-profile --inference-profile-identifier <id>

inference_profile_id.description: Geographic (us.) profile: requests stay in US Regions. Never a global. profile for this app (lesson 11.5).

max_tokens.description: Output cap per request (cost safety, LLM06:2026).

prompt_log_retention_days.description: Prompts and answers are personal data in most helpdesks. Keep them only as long as investigations need them.

region.description: Source Region. The us. profile below routes from us-east-1 to us-east-1, us-east-2 and us-west-2 (AWS model card).
